ticket_context: KARST-256 pre-deployment live-network scale check (local machine, not cloud)
code_base: daily-scale 69c844a (core 0.2.15); the symbol_for share-class fix is committed with this receipt
path: in-process fastmcp Client against karst.mcp_server.build(): refresh_daily_scope -> get_daily_runs(wait_seconds=40) -> resume_daily_scope; refresh_daily for single members. Fresh scratch KARST_DATA_DIR; no cloud, no production list, no reader site, no account tools.
prices_only_method: Runs A and C and the resume replaced karst.fetch.news.http_get in the driver process with an empty RSS feed (news coverage reads ok with zero items); the daily path always requests prices+news and has no prices-only switch.
registration: service.ensure_company (identity only, no fetch) per member + knowledge.save universe live200-scale, so Run A is the true first-run history backfill (windowed fetch, then full recovery).

universe.method: median(close*volume) over the last 60 trading days to 2026-09-02 (local yfinance parquet, series_role=primary); entities.parquet NYSE/NASDAQ, not etp_suspect, not foreign filer; ticker == primary_ticker; class-suffixed tickers excluded; top 200

runs.run: A prices only, first run (history backfill)
C prices only, immediately after B (incremental)
resume of run C: retries only incomplete members

single_refresh.subject: NASDAQ:DDOG
single_refresh.note: quota-blocked member fails alone and returns in 7 s

cross_check.what: stored Longbridge closes vs local yfinance parquet, 2026-07-01..09-02, per member (detects a cross-thread response mix-up)

outliers.reason: 2:1 split effective 2026-09-03: yfinance history is split-adjusted, Longbridge NoAdjust is raw (160.08 on 9/02, 82.07 on 9/03). Not a mix-up.

findings.what: Longbridge account quota: "history candlestick symbol count out of limit, requested:100/limit:100" (OpenAPI code 301607). Distinct symbols with history candles are capped at 100 for this account; 94 of the 200 new members got history, 106 failed in every run. quote/static_info/calc_indexes are unaffected.
findings.consequence: 200 securities cannot be served by this account through history_candlesticks regardless of code. Options: a higher Longbridge quote package, a second daily-bar source for members over quota, or a daily list kept within the quota.
findings.side_effect: This test used up the remaining quota slots. The 10 production daily-monitoring symbols were re-checked afterwards and still return candles (already counted). A symbol newly added to production will fail history until the vendor quota window frees slots (window length not verified).

findings.what: The quota failure is classified cause=error, not a distinct quota cause, and a quota-blocked member repeats a windowed fetch plus a full recovery fetch (8 vendor calls) on every run and every resume; resume cannot fix it.

karst.fetch.longbridge.symbol_for passed any dotted ticker through as if it carried a market suffix, so a share-class ticker such as BRK.B was sent as BRK.B (the vendor returns nothing) instead of BRK.B.US (verified live). Now only US/HK/SH/SZ/SG suffixes pass through; test added. Class-suffixed tickers were excluded from this universe because of it.
NoAdjust daily series cross splits unadjusted (APH 2026-09-03); technicals over such a series see a false 50% drop. Existing design choice, not changed here.
No snapshot events, L5/L6 price queue or news queue entries: none of these members has research or a plan, so triage has nothing to compare against. Queue behaviour at scale is not measured here.

The karst-source attempt pool grows to its 64-thread cap and keeps idle threads after a run (ThreadPoolExecutor behaviour); no vendor call was left in flight after any run, no karst-daily thread survived a run.

prices_plus_technicals_le_300s.evidence: A 175 s (backfill), C 167 s (incremental) with 106 quota-failing members each spending 8 calls; about 80-90 s projected for 200 healthy incremental members (4 calls each at the 10/s gate)

with_news_le_600s.evidence: B 214 s; RSS attempt p50 about 1 s, max 3.5 s

each_call_le_60s.evidence: max MCP call 41.1 s (40 s wait plus reply)

zero_full_refetch_when_history_sufficien.evidence: B and C: 94/94 members with history fetched from the last complete bar, 0 full re-fetches; the 106 full fetches were members without history (quota)

failure_isolation_and_rerun.evidence: 106 failures never blocked the 94; resume retried only the 106 (848 calls = 106 x 8) and kept the 94 successes; a single refresh of one member works alone

serve_200_securities.cause: Longbridge history-candle symbol quota of 100 on this account

open_questions_answered.longbridge_client_thread_safety: Safe in practice: one shared SdkClient across 8 workers (5 in flight) for 4,896 calls in four runs; no SDK exception besides the quota code, no quote symbol mismatch, stored closes match an independent source for 93/94 members (the outlier is a real split). Empirical, not a proof of SDK internals.
open_questions_answered.sqlite_busy_timeout: No "database is locked" error in any run (8 worker connections plus the MCP connection).
open_questions_answered.hung_threads_after_vendor_timeout: Not exercised: zero timeouts live (slowest attempt 3.5 s), still unproven.

does_not_prove: cloud CPU, disk and network (Zeabur container) timings
a true next-day new bar: C ran minutes after B with no new bar, so merging a genuinely new bar is not shown live
200 members with history on this account (quota)
triage queue volume with researched members
behaviour under vendor timeouts or HTTP 429 (none occurred)

rerun_latest_candles_endpoint.code_base: daily-scale 4596108: daily bars from QuoteContext.candlesticks (latest <=1000 bars, no per-account symbol cap) whenever 1000 bars reach the requested start; history_candlesticks_by_date only for an older explicit start; 301607 is cause=quota and never retried
rerun_latest_candles_endpoint.path: same in-process fastmcp driver and the same 200 members; fresh scratch KARST_DATA_DIR (data2) registered identity-only, so Run A is again the true first-run backfill. A and C prices only (empty RSS in the driver), B prices + news.

runs.run: A prices only, first run (history backfill)

rerun_latest_candles_endpoint.endpoint_used: 600 landed candle records, all tool=candlesticks, all ok; zero history_candlesticks_by_date calls. count=1000 for the full backfill, 8 for the windowed first fetch, 7 for the incremental fetch from the last complete bar (2026-09-22).

overlap_check.direct: MU.US, NVDA.US, JPM.US (symbols already holding history quota): both endpoints, no start -> 1000 bars each, 2022-09-27..2026-09-22, 1000/1000 overlapping bars with identical open/high/low/close/volume/turnover/timestamp/trade_session, identical basis (NoAdjust, Day, trade_session unknown = SDK default; rows carry trade_session Intraday). Windowed start 2026-09-15 on MU.US and JPM.US: 6 rows each, byte-identical responses.
overlap_check.stored_series: The 94 members that got history in the first run (data, history endpoint) vs the same members in this re-run (data2, latest endpoint): 92,012 overlapping stored daily bars, 0 differences in open/high/low/close/volume/complete.
overlap_check.quota_blocked_symbol: DDOG.US: latest endpoint ok (1000 bars); history endpoint still refused with 301607.

prices_le_300s.evidence: A 278 s (first-run backfill, 8 calls per member at the 10/s gate), C 121 s (incremental)

each_call_le_60s.evidence: max MCP call 41.0 s (40 s wait plus reply); max vendor attempt 3.45 s

notes_for_cloud_deploy: Landed candle evidence changes tool name from history_candlesticks_by_date to candlesticks and params gain count; series selection groups by symbol and basis, not tool, so existing history snapshots still extend the new series (verified: 0 differences on 92,012 bars).
Depth is 1000 bars (back to 2022-09-27 today); an explicit start older than that still goes to the history endpoint and is subject to the 100-symbol cap.
Trading sessions: neither call passes trade_sessions; the SDK default returns regular-session (Intraday) bars on both.
A forming bar for today was not observed live (market closed during the test); completion is decided downstream by exchange close vs fetch time, unit-tested for rows from this endpoint.

First-run backfill still spends 8 Longbridge calls per member (windowed fetch, then full recovery); 278 s for 200 is close to the 300 s target. Fetching full history directly when stored history is known insufficient would halve it; not changed here.
